prior_comparison.priorprotocolnote: Comparison across all nine validation windows, 2024-02-06 through 2025-12-29. Each architecture uses its own completed intersection with prior results: up to 103,901 identical forecasts across 393 tickers; row counts are shown per comparison. Same base features, target normalization, empirical baseline and 201-quantile/101-tail-point scoring. Prior models were selected on 2023 warmup data with varying learning rates, batches and widths; advanced models use their declared fixed settings. This compares fitted systems, not architecture alone. Options arms excluded; ticker wins are point estimates, not significance claims.

metric_definitions.skill_pct_ratio_of_sums: 100 * (1 - sum(model score) / sum(empirical baseline score)); positive is better than baseline.
metric_definitions.advanced_improvement_over_prior_pct_rati: 100 * (1 - sum(advanced score) / sum(prior score)); positive is better than the prior fitted model.
metric_definitions.ticker_wins: Strictly lower total score on that ticker across the paired completed windows; point estimates only.
metric_definitions.equal_ticker: Mean of each paired ticker total-score ratio; supplemental, not the ratio-of-sums report headline.

limitations: Base features only: options arms change fit populations and cannot isolate architecture versus the prior experiment.
No claim of architecture-only causation: prior models were selected using 2023 warmup scores and have model/regime-specific learning rates, batch sizes, widths and training budgets.
Forecast targets are traced to matching panel SHA256 and target/reference normalization; raw datasets were not reopened.
No significance testing or training, refit, holdout evaluation performed.

All advanced architectures/regimes inherit canonical identity and rowwise baseline verification from the completed independent final artifact audit; final aggregate data and its manifest hashes are pinned here.
Paired scores compare the saved fitted systems; prior tuning versus advanced fixed settings means this does not isolate architecture quality.
Ticker wins are point estimates, not statistically confirmed discoveries; selecting a best architecture after viewing these folds remains exploratory.

reproducibility.full_manifest_not_copied_reason: The local manifest contains 69540 per-fit source records and is 16MB; this bounded bundle retains its identity and location, audit result, source/dependency pins and aggregate comparisons.
reproducibility.recipe_retention_note: Local frozen-run and /tmp recipe files must be retained with the execution workspace to reproduce extraction. Hashes identify exact scripts; they are not embedded here.

integration_provenance_guard.required_behavior: Verify the executing source tree; historical configuration must refuse on changed executing bytes before dataset access, rather than certify another checkout.
integration_provenance_guard.historical_result_impact: Frozen training candidate and scored artifacts unchanged. This integration correction does not rerun or re-score the study.

limitations: Training-only scaler/median values and band identity hashes cannot be independently recomputed without rereading source rows; frozen reviewed code, persisted metadata, manifests and cross-model paired forecast artifacts are verified. No raw source rows or holdout loaded.
One seed and one 31-day horizon; no new significance or multiple-comparison procedure run.
Architecture rankings are exploratory; row matching does not equalize optimizers, batches, widths, hardware or prior selection.
Options admission requires at least one observed option field per row, not every field; missing component fields remain training-only median imputed.
Unpooled option/control head and native settings differ for some paired fits; their score differences do not isolate the added features.
Skipped fits and capacity refusals are not successful training; no excluded result is substituted into a comparison.
No holdout opened, no production decision or trading authorization, no new training during final extraction.
